_readme: Settings for the trial. Edit this file on GitHub and press Commit changes — nothing needs rebuilding, and testers pick it up the next time they open the app. Leave a value as "" to switch that feature off.
_sheetEndpoint: Paste the Apps Script web-app URL here, the one ending in /exec. Feedback then goes into your Google Sheet as it is written. See docs/GOOGLE-SHEET-SETUP.md.
_sheetToken: Must match the TOKEN line in the Apps Script. Change both together.
_nodalWhatsApp: Country code, no + and no spaces, e.g. 919876543210. Used by the Send now button.
_formUrl: Optional Google Form, offered as a second way to send feedback.
_appPasscode: Asked for before the app opens. A latch, not a lock — see docs/ACCESS-CONTROL.md.
_reviewPasscode: Asked for before the See all feedback received screen opens.
